svg.title: MikuSwarm context assembly
svg.desc: The context one agent session is built from, top to bottom: system prompt, diary, hierarchical summaries, compact and rich chat tiers, satellite runtime state with tail instructions, and the trigger message, followed by the session's own rollout. Colored brackets map each tier back to the span of chat messages it renders; older chat fades upward into the summaries.
svg.text: last 2 days of entries, from every room
